propositions: _recover_dirty_merge fails and gives up when an untracked local file collides with a file the merge wants to create, leaving the colliding untracked file in the working tree and causing every retry to fail identically

Push recovery must quarantine named untracked colliding paths using the shared sync parser and directory helpers, retry the merge once, and restore the stash exactly once on all exit paths to match reconverge behavior
Genuine content conflicts and paths not named by git status must keep their original behavior (merge abort, stash restore, warn/strict-raise) unchanged
The quarantine move must be implemented through core._git in push_recovery (not calling across the sync module seam) to preserve the ~25 existing test monkeypatch sites
Untracked overwrite detection must fence all named paths against git status --porcelain -uall '??' before moving anything to prevent mis-parses from relocating tracked data
